design_inputs.R1_wire_clarification: One UTF-8 JSON frame containing registered ASCII keys/values plus exactly one terminal LF. The256-byte cap includes LF; no length header, CR or BOM. Reject an accumulated prefix or full frame above256 bytes before JSON parsing.
design_inputs.four_added_controls: N175..N178 specify the two-stage protected-B bootstrap and docs-only final-C activation; all are metadata single-mutation controls and add zero execution.
design_inputs.fixture_timing_clarification: Before any implementation/run, root review identified P04 would otherwise start cleanup only after its final1s cap. All7 now reserve fixed200ms inside1s, trigger work timeout at800ms, and require cleanup by1s; fixture identities/counts/expected outcomes and10s/180s budgets unchanged.

STRICT_SCHEMA_TEMPLATE.description: One strictly valid bounded R1 record in the final registered schema. A synthetic metadata template is never a provider, kernel, process or science observation.

SOURCE_AND_GUARD_TEMPLATE.description: Reviewed protected-B source/policy bytes, actual bounded diff and a valid source/event authority template; no candidate policy is the expected-policy oracle.

FRESH_BUILD_CLOSURE.description: Copies of the registered actual build recipes, dependency inventory, source identities and retained original ELF/archive bytes. No compiler, linker or target is rerun by a negative.

ENGINEERING_P01_ORIGINAL.description: Copies of the successful registered P01 original status/stat/exe, six wire records and owned wait/supervisor evidence; no extra launcher or child is started.

BOUNDED_BYTE_SCHEMA_TEMPLATE.description: Valid compact serialized-record templates with explicit spare space outside the one tested field; construct exactly the stated boundary length in memory, never a real proc write or target invocation.

SINGLE_COMPLETE_SCIENCE_COHORT.description: Isolated copies of the one complete original 36-target/21600-frame cohort. Default selected case is native/ALL_P/repeat1/reference unless the selector names another case. Every other original is unchanged.

TIMING_ORDER_STATISTIC_TEMPLATE.description: A valid bounded synthetic 600-frame timing-only vector with strictly increasing values1..600 ns for the tested role, correct raw summaries, exactly1.0s owned-target CPU and2.0s owned-target wall, and legal remaining fields. Bind starts at CPU0/wall0. It is never a DSP result or replacement for science timing.

BUDGET_AND_JOBS_TEMPLATE.description: Strict bounded valid original Jobs request/body/deadline and stage/command templates, with full 180-second admission, a unique dedicated F1 job and consistent run/attempt/event-head identity. The real acquisition remains separately mandatory.

FREEZE_PROVIDER_TEMPLATE.description: A complete bounded valid PRE/POST provider template for fixed issue845. Each comments page contains one valid matching-C freeze and one valid other-C freeze, with distinct IDs and matching bracketing counts. Both may have the same full tree but different actual commit identities. Templates cannot authorize a run.

EVENT_SCOPE_TEMPLATE.description: One valid provider-bound PR C/B/M or protected-main S-to-merged-PR C/B template and protected-B guard execution evidence. Main association templates contain exactly one matching merged PR; variants explicitly named by a control remain synthetic metadata.

engineering_fixtures.name: complete-positive
engineering_fixtures.behavior: One direct native fixture child follows PREEXEC, ENTRY and RETURN with all three ACKs, then exits0. Its body performs no DSP.

engineering_fixtures.name: exec-absent
engineering_fixtures.behavior: The launcher forks once; PREEXEC and its ACK complete. Direct execve targets an absent executable in the isolated fixture directory and reports the real ENOENT. The owned child exits127; ENTRY and RETURN are absent.

engineering_fixtures.name: main-returns-seven
engineering_fixtures.behavior: PREEXEC, ENTRY and RETURN complete; RETURN reports return_code7 and actual owned wait reports exit7. This is an expected engineering rejection with zero validated science frames.

engineering_fixtures.name: stall-after-ENTRY
engineering_fixtures.behavior: PREEXEC and ENTRY complete with ACKs, then the direct child stalls without RETURN. At the fixed original invocation origin+800000000ns work deadline, report F1R1_ENGINEERING_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT and SIGKILL only the identified owned child, followed by its exact wait4. The original origin+1000000000ns final deadline includes launch/setup/protocol/kill/reap/encoding and is never restarted. A qualifying expected rejection requires final SIGKILL9 and complete owned reap/evidence before that1s deadline; late cleanup is a separate qualification failure.
engineering_fixtures.expected_reason_semantics: The registered reason denotes exhaustion of the fixed800ms engineering work window, not permission to begin cleanup after the final1s envelope.

engineering_fixtures.name: wire-257-byte-frame
engineering_fixtures.behavior: After PREEXEC/ACK and successful fixture exec, the child writes exactly256 ASCII x bytes plus one LF as one257-byte logical wire frame, then waits. The launcher rejects by size before JSON decoding, sends no ACK for it, SIGKILLs its owned child and reaps it; a JSON parse error alone does not satisfy this fixture.

engineering_fixtures.name: EOF-without-ENTRY
engineering_fixtures.behavior: After PREEXEC/ACK the fixture exec succeeds, closes its checkpoint channel and exits0 before sending ENTRY. Successful exec-error-pipe EOF and final exit0 cannot create an ENTRY observation or a complete case.

engineering_fixtures.name: one-waited-descendant
engineering_fixtures.behavior: After ENTRY the direct fixture child creates exactly one non-DSP descendant and waits for that exact PID; the descendant exits0 before the direct child sends RETURN and exits0. Retain fork/wait lineage. There is no RSS threshold, required increase, exclusive-main-image claim or concurrent-tree-sum claim.

engineering_budget.descendant_lineage_retained_in: bounded engineering diagnostic/control record within existing envelope; no new unbudgeted proc member
engineering_budget.clock_origin: Immediately before starting the native launcher; setup, fork, exec and all handshakes consume the same original clock.
engineering_budget.work_and_cleanup: Every fixture uses fixed work deadline origin+800000000ns and final completion deadline origin+1000000000ns, each also bounded by remaining batch/stage/job. Stop normal work at the work deadline; owned kill/reap and complete bounded evidence encoding must finish by the final deadline. The200ms reserve is inside1s and never borrowed to extend work. A shorter enclosing remaining window rejects before starting a fixture.
engineering_budget.late_cleanup: If cleanup/reap/encoding ends after the original1s deadline, preserve bounded failure but mark the fixture/batch qualification failed; expected semantic rejection cannot override a budget failure.

rules.logical_selectors: Selectors name the final R1 validator record view, not an implemented file API. The owner must map each selector one-to-one to the final serialized schema and raw-source parser before freeze; unmapped controls block execution rather than silently skip.
rules.logical_entrypoints: R1_<CATEGORY>_READBACK names a pure bounded validator boundary, not an existing function. Final source must provide the reviewed mapping. Identity fields that require raw-source consistency are checked against parsed original raw bytes, not merely compared between self-authored summaries.

rules.wire_ordinal_role: Case/invocation ordinal; the same ordinal is retained across PREEXEC/ENTRY/RETURN/ACK within one invocation. Phase carries the checkpoint order.
rules.base_positive_required: The unmodified bounded input must pass the same validator entrypoint before its negative is attempted. A rejection caused only by malformed construction or a changed transport checksum does not count as the intended control.
rules.resealing_policy: After the one declared mutation, recompute only enclosing local transport/manifest hashes, raw-byte counts and directly derived parse views needed to reach the named semantic predicate. Never change independently expected source pins, other raw observations, actual provider identities, untouched peer repetitions, limits, or decision rules to accommodate the mutation.
rules.expected_reason_contract: Each new R1 reason denotes the registered first violated semantic predicate at its named validator entrypoint. A generic exception, parse failure for a size test, timeout, crash or missing dependency is not a successful negative.
rules.bootstrap_preparation: After separate root docs-freeze authorization, source/static compilation/pure in-process offline controls may be prepared without running any F1 process. Qualification must still rerun applicable pure controls on the registered actual inputs inside the same180s execution stage; preparatory output is not a registered cohort.
